An unclosed BT at the end of a stream is reported (TEXT_OBJECT_LEFT_OPEN) for the same loss; a nested one is not. The BT comment says the outlines are 'the only state a second BT could otherwise carry'.

summary: TJ reads every pending operand as an element of its array. The content lexer flattens arrays and leaves each bracket as a null; set_dash splits on those nulls, but ShowTextAdjusted iterates all operands, so a leftover number before the [ is applied as a position adjustment (5000 [(A) (A)] TJ draws the first glyph at x -40 where [(A) (A)] TJ draws it at 10), a string outside any array is shown ((A) -1000 (A) TJ draws two glyphs with no array), and a string inside an array nested in the operand is shown ([(A) [(A)] (A)] TJ draws three). Nothing is reported. The comment says the flattened operands are 'enough to render them correctly'.
source: ISO 32000-2 Table 107, TJ: "Each element of array shall be either a string or a number. If the element is a string, this operator shall show the string. If it is a number, the operator shall adjust the text position by that amount".
